Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Sent: Thursday, July 9, 2015 6:01 PM
To: Bull, Kevin <kbull@freepress.com>
Subject: Re: J.D. hitting coach 
 
Yeah, that will work. I just needed more than like ... Friday at 7 p.m.

From: Bull, Kevin
Sent: Thursday, July 9, 2015 5:59 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony
Subject: RE: J.D. hitting coach 
 
Dude, I’m heading to a cottage in Tawas City at 9:30 a.m. Saturday. Can I get it before that? Or at least the bulk of it or lead of it?

From: Fenech, Anthony 
Sent: Thursday, July 09, 2015 5:56 PM
To: Bull, Kevin
Subject: Re: J.D. hitting coach
I wasn't really thinking of building it around him, just in case I could get a hold of him, if I could throw in a quote there without being named. I've been unable to yet, though.
I'm getting my final sit down with J.D. tomorrow at 3 p.m. If I got you something by noon on Saturday would that be OK?

From: Bull, Kevin
Sent: Thursday, July 9, 2015 4:40 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony
Subject: RE: J.D. hitting coach

Yeah, we can’t build this story around an anonymous coach. Just can’t. That said, he could still be part of the story. Can mention how during his final winter with the Astros he found a coach, who he does not want to name or discuss their time together out of respect for his coaches now. Mention how that coach helped change his swing but he still have to work hard to put the principles in place. Maybe he can talk about how Wally or anyone else helped complete the transition? Can JD say something nice about Wally too to help balance it?

From: Fenech, Anthony 
Sent: Thursday, July 09, 2015 3:36 PM
To: Bull, Kevin
Subject: Re: J.D. hitting coach
We'll see if I can even get a hold of him...

I can’t. I can’t say, he doesn’t want me to say and I gotta respect that. I asked around , I asked the guys and somebody got him recommended to me and then I chcekd into him and I mean, he doesn’t want me to say anything yet. He says the day that you sign a contract then you can say who I am. The day you sign and you don’t have to worry – and this is between us – you can’t sit here and tell, you can’t give credit to somebody that’s not your hitting coach, it’s an insult to Wally, it’s an insult to them so if I do that then I insult them and you don’t want that because you don’t’ want that friction in the clubhouse and the day you sign a contract, they don’t give a fuck. Like there’s nothing they can do, nothing they can say. But the day you kinda like, you know where you’re going to be for the next few years. The day you sign a contract where you know where you’e going to be for the next 4-5 years you know where I’ve made my money and done my stuff then he’d be like I don’t care, say it then, but he goes, out of protection for you.
When I first went to him.

No. I cjust called him out of the blue, I said I’m jd martinez, I want to come work with you, I love the way you teach and what you’ve talked about and I need to see you , I’ve heard great things about you and I want to come check you out. Two weeks .. he was the guy that guided me the whole time. I knew what I wanted to do but he was the guy that guided me and he still does guide me but that’s between me and you.

From: Bull, Kevin
Sent: Thursday, July 9, 2015 3:09 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony
Subject: Re: J.D. hitting coach
I guess I don't understand why he doesn't want his name out. He's getting props, right? Is it not proper protocol or does it look bad for Tigers? What is problem?
On Jul 9, 2015, at 2:56 PM, Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com> wrote:
I'm closing in on him. J.D. wouldn't give me his name but I got it from one of Boras' guys. I called his co-worker earlier today.
He wants to keep a low profile, J.D. said, and he wants to keep him anonymous so if I get a hold of him, can I tell him that I won't use his name? His name is Craig Wallenbrock.
